# Pass 1 unified every commit onto the account noreply address;
# pass 2 (this file) unified every commit onto the verified

# messages, dates, and parents are byte-identical; only the

# run logs, PRs, and notes. Rows without an original-era hash
# (commits born after pass 1) carry '-' in that column.
